title: New Partner Marketing Hub: Smarter Campaigns and AI-Powered Tools
subject: Meet the enhanced Partner Marketing Hub: More marketing impact, less busywork
body:
Hi [Partner First Name],

Big news! The Hitachi Vantara Partner Marketing Hub just got smarter.

The enhanced Partner Marketing Hub (PMH) makes it easier to discover, personalize, launch, and measure marketing activities that help you engage customers and generate demand.

MORE MARKETING IMPACT. LESS BUSYWORK.

Here's how the PMH can help:

Launch campaigns faster. Explore ready-to-use Hitachi Vantara campaigns with automatically co-branded emails, landing pages, and social posts. Customize approved materials to fit your audience.

Put AI to work. Use built-in AI assistance, including Maia, to discover campaigns, refine messages, and identify your next steps. Translate campaign content for audiences in other markets.

Make social outreach easier. Personalize ready-made social content and bring it into your marketing plan without starting from scratch.

Engage and follow up. Activate email campaigns, manage your contacts, and use campaign reporting to see engagement and follow up on interested customers.

Extend your reach. Use web content syndication to showcase Hitachi Vantara solutions on your website.

You don't need a large marketing team to get started. The PMH brings campaign resources and practical tools together in one place.

EXPLORE THE PARTNER MARKETING HUB
https://www.partnermarketing.hitachivantara.com/

Start by checking your company profile, browsing the Campaign Library, and choosing an activity that supports your business goals.

ALREADY USING THE PMH? PLEASE REVIEW YOUR TRANSITION STEPS.

The previous PMH experience is scheduled to remain available until December 10, 2026. Before that date, download historical contacts, leads, reports, or customized content you want to retain. Review your company profile, check your email-domain authentication if you send email through PMH, and update web content syndication where applicable.

VIEW SETUP AND TRANSITION GUIDANCE
https://www.partnermarketing.hitachivantara.com/Transition-Guide-PMH

LET'S PUT IT TO WORK FOR YOUR BUSINESS.

Have a solution to promote, a new market to reach, or a demand generation goal? Reply to this email and let's find a campaign to help you get started. I can also connect you with our Partner Marketing team for a personalized walkthrough.

Looking forward to helping you make the most of these capabilities.

[Your Name]
Partner Account Manager
Hitachi Vantara
